info.title: Harem in the Labyrinth of Another World
info.synopsis: Un ragazzo ha intenzione di suicidarsi e cerca su internet un modo per morire. Mentre naviga s'imbatte in uno strano sito che gli pone molte domande per poi permettergli di creare delle particolari abilità in base ad un sistema basato sui punti. Interessato, inizia a rispondere alle domande e a creare il suo personaggio, quando alla fine gli viene chiesto: "Adesso verrai trasportato in un altro mondo insieme alla caratteristiche che hai scelto, non ci sarà modo di fare ritorno, accetti?". Senza pensarci troppo il ragazzo accetta e si ritrova in un mondo parallelo con le abilità e le caratteristiche che lui stesso si è dato.

episodes.title: Incontro
episodes.synopsis: Kaga Michio, who thought he was simply opening the settings menu of a PC game, finds himself inside the game world. Equipment, levels, stats, and settings... Approaching the situation like a typical video game, Michio saves a village from bandits as his first quest. However, Michio discovers that he can't leave this world he believed was just a game by logging out or exiting...

episodes.title: Guadagnare denaro
episodes.synopsis: Michio must raise the required funds within five days in order to purchase Roxanne from Alan's mansion. Like everyone else, Michio hunts monsters in the labyrinth and gathers items. However, even with Michio's skills, he won't make enough money in time. An anxious Michio recalls Alan telling him about a way to earn a large amount of money in a short period of time.

episodes.title: Acquisizione
episodes.synopsis: Michio stakes his hopes on hunting bandits for bounties and searches for targets around town at night. Though he finds them easily using his skills, they are still human. Conflicted feelings about killing people for money and the fear of needing to defeat his opponents swirl inside Michio. However, with the time limit approaching, Michio steels his resolve and enters the bandits' headquarters!

episodes.title: Bagno
episodes.synopsis: Michio moves his home base to Quratar and begins his new life. Having completed their preliminary inspection of the labyrinth, Michio and Roxanne decide to make a farm at the house so they can grow herbs. The two of them spend an entire day completing the work, and by the end of it, both of them are covered in dirt. Michio goes out shopping for a washtub so Roxanne can wash their clothes, and a conversation with the shopkeeper inspires Michio to create the bathroom of his dreams.
